description: Fuaran DAG-record wire-format conformance corpus (Phase 178; re-addressed by Phase 1144; re-minted by Phase 2645, the cut). dag-record-round-trip: decode inputFile, re-encode, assert byte-equal to expectedFile. Since Phase 2645 a record is a Fuaran.Core DAG node over the linear chain's provenance envelope, and its hash is Core's Dag.nodeId: the chain's SHA-256 hash function over (the sorted parents joined by a comma, Actor.encode(actor) + '|' + StreamEntry.encode({op, ts, promptId, result})), so every host also recomputes each fixture's hash from its own fields. A merge node is an ordinary node whose op is its reconciliation script as a Batch. outcomeHash and tombstoned were retired (a pruned node leaves the live set for a sink's skeleton); a record carrying either is a pre-2645 record whose address does not recompute. The op field nests the canonical TreeOp wire form and the actor field the canonical typed-actor form, both verbatim. See WIRE_FORMAT.md.
